CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to identified content organization/access was found.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), an explicit origin/status entry, and separate content listing co-occur for the same referent/time, showing identification, presentation/access and status differentiation.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to the identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified contents (colour-labeled coordinate sets) for named referents and times.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata and content coordinates are given separately for the same referent/time, distinguishing content identification from its provenance/status.

O.rationale: The report states how content entries were produced/represented (origin fields and current/candidate markers), indicating presentation/access/organization.
